title: as (as I walked … / as I was … etc.)

exercises.instruction: In this exercise as means 'at the same time as'. Use as to join sentences from the boxes.

parts: We all waved goodbye to Liz
she drove away.
I listened
she told me her story.
answers: as she told me her story

parts: I burnt myself
I was taking a hot dish out of the oven.
answers: as I was taking a hot dish out of the oven

parts: The spectators cheered
the two teams came onto the field.
answers: as the two teams came onto the field

parts: A dog ran out in front of the car
we were driving along the road.
answers: as we were driving along the road

exercises.instruction: In this exercise as means 'because'. Join sentences from the boxes beginning with as.

parts: As I was hungry,
I decided to find somewhere to eat.
answers: As I was hungry, I decided to find somewhere to eat.

parts: As
today is a public holiday, all government offices are shut.
answers: As today is a public holiday, all government offices are shut.

parts: As
I didn't want to disturb anybody, I tried to be very quiet.
answers: As I didn't want to disturb anybody, I tried to be very quiet.

parts: As
I can't go to the concert, you can have my ticket.
answers: As I can't go to the concert, you can have my ticket.

parts: As
it was a nice day, we went for a walk by the canal.
answers: As it was a nice day, we went for a walk by the canal.

exercises.instruction: What does as mean in each sentence?
leftOptions: 1 As they lived near us, we used to see them quite often.
2 Kate slipped as she was getting off the bus.
3 As I was tired, I went to bed early.
4 Unfortunately, as I was parking the car, I hit the car behind me.
5 As we climbed the hill, we got more and more tired.
6 We decided to go out to eat as we had no food at home.
7 As we don't use the car very often, we've decided to sell it.

exercises.instruction: In some of the sentences, as is not correct. Correct them where necessary.

items.prompt: Julia got married as she was 22.
As the day went on, the weather got worse.
He dropped the glass as he was taking it out of the cupboard.
I lost my phone as I was in London.
As I left school, I didn't know what to do.
answers: When I left school, I didn't know what to do.

items.prompt: The train slowed down as it approached the station.
I used to live near the sea as I was a child.
We can walk to the hotel as it isn't far from here.

exercises.instruction: Use your own ideas to complete the sentences.

items.prompt: Just as I sat down, the doorbell rang.
modelAnswers: Just as I sat down, the doorbell rang.
I saw you as you were getting into your car.

items.prompt: It started to rain just as
modelAnswers: It started to rain just as we started playing tennis.

items.prompt: As she doesn't have a phone,
modelAnswers: As she doesn't have a phone, it's quite difficult to contact her.

items.prompt: Just as I took the picture,
modelAnswers: Just as I took the picture, somebody walked in front of my phone.
